d_and_a.source: Depreciation (15.2B/22.0B/34.3B) + AmortizationOfIntangibleAssets (4.8B/6.0B/4.7B), accession 0001193125-26-323660; matches tool EBITDA definition

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2026 growth was 17.8% (331,839 vs 281,724); fading toward mature growth as the base gets larger and AI/cloud demand normalizes.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2026 margin 46.8% (155,237/331,839), FY2025 45.6%; slightly lower for depreciation pressure from heavy AI capex.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: FY2026 effective tax approx. 19.4% (pretax 165,934 vs net income 133,749 per 10-K 0001193125-26-323660); 18% reflects a stable mid/high-teens rate, rounded.

da_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2026 D&A 39.0B/331.8B = 11.8%; rising as the capex build depreciates.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2026 capex 34.9% of revenue (115,948/331,839), FY2025 22.9%; assume moderation from peak AI build-out.

wacc.source: CAPM: Rf 4.86% (US Treasury 10Y par, 2026-11-06) + assumed beta ~1.05 x ERP 4.46% (Damodaran US, 2026-02-16) = ~9.5% cost of equity; debt is about 40B vs equity value of well over 3T, so WACC ~ cost of equity. Beta is an assumption (not looked up).

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: below the long-run nominal GDP growth and below the 4.86% risk-free rate.

net_debt.source: financial_statements derived net_debt = total debt 40,294 (LTD noncurrent 31,067 + current 9,227) - cash 20,935 - short-term investments 55,908; accession 0001193125-26-323660
